qualification_rule: A ready route needs a durable pre-existing identity in the named community, a healthy free bounded server-side operation requiring no account, key, authentication, payment, terms, installation or persistent configuration, exact independent Agent Guild trust/passport/preflight/credential consumption, and attributable substantive result evidence. Liveness, probes, listings, offers, schema checks, acknowledgements, caller-supplied-only validation and self-claimed identity do not qualify.
